name: Spoon
label: Matador
lede: Two guys from an Austin rockabilly band made a $3,000 debut for Matador, got signed and dumped by a major in one year, wrote a single about the man who did it, and then put out a decade of records so consistent that Metacritic named them its top artist of the 2000s.

eras.title: Named after a Can song
eras.text: Britt Daniel and Jim Eno met in an Austin rockabilly trio and started their own band, named for a Can song. A debut album cost $3,000 and got them to New York's Matador Records.

years.h: Britt Daniel and Jim Eno start Spoon in Austin
years.p: Britt Daniel and Jim Eno meet in the rockabilly trio The Alien Beats. With Greg Wilson on guitar and Andy Maguire on bass, they name the band after Can's song Spoon.
years.xp: Daniel, born in Galveston and raised in Temple, Texas, had already been through high school band the Zygotes and a UT Austin band called Skellington. He had worked as a sound designer and composer for the game company Origin Systems.

years.h: Nefarious EP, on vinyl
years.p: Spoon's first release, a vinyl EP. Britt Daniel is also putting out experimental music as Drake Tungsten.

years.h: Spoon records Telephono in John Croslin's garage for $3,000
years.p: Producer John Croslin, who briefly played bass in Spoon in 1996, records the debut in his garage studio. Matador signs Spoon the same year.

eras.title: The Pixies problem
eras.text: The Matador debut came out to reviews that kept saying Pixies. The bass chair turned over again and again, and by 1997 Daniel had decided Matador thought his band was too commercial.

years.h: Telephono · Matador, compared to the Pixies
years.p: Spoon's debut LP sells only a few thousand copies at first. Texas Monthly calls it snarling, devious and ultra-catchy.

years.h: Andy Maguire leaves and Spoon cycles through bassists
years.p: After Andy Maguire, John Croslin, Hunter Darby and Scott 'Clanky' Adair all hold the bass job before the end of 1997.

years.h: Soft Effects EP, sparer and smarter
years.p: Matador's second Spoon release shows the minimalist, clipped style that would become Britt Daniel's signature.

years.h: Joshua Zarbo joins after a gig at the Argo in Denton
years.p: Joshua Zarbo, who caught Spoon at the Argo in Denton, Texas, auditions and takes bass for the next nine years.

years.h: Spoon leaves Matador for Elektra
years.p: By mid-1997 Britt Daniel feels Matador sees Spoon as too commercial. Elektra's Ron Laffitte has been chasing the band for over a year; Spoon agrees to go.

eras.title: The agony of Laffitte
eras.text: Spoon's one major-label album lasted about four months. The executive who signed them got fired, the band got dropped, and Daniel answered with a single named after him.

years.h: A Series of Sneaks · Elektra
years.p: Spoon signs to Elektra in February and recorded the album across six Austin studios in 1997. By January 1999 it is out of print.

years.h: Elektra drops Spoon four months after the album
years.p: Elektra VP Ron Laffitte chased Spoon for a year, stopped returning calls once they signed, and was fired shortly after release. Spoon is dropped four months later.
years.xp: The label move had come after the album was mostly recorded, so Elektra had bought a finished record and then let it disappear. Daniel later compared its sales unfavourably with a single week of the next album.

years.h: The Agony of Laffitte single · Saddle Creek
years.p: Two songs about Ron Laffitte, The Agony of Laffitte and Laffitte Don't Fail Me Now, released on Omaha's Saddle Creek Records.

years.h: Britt Daniel temps in New York; Jim Eno designs chips
years.p: With a 10-song album done by May, Britt Daniel does temp work in New York while Jim Eno designs semiconductor chips in Austin. Labels reject the demos week after week.
years.xp: Producer Mike McCarthy and Matador's Gerard Cosloy showed interest. McCarthy reworked the record, cut songs aimed at the old A&R man and added three new ones, and Daniel called it the hardest album to make.

eras.title: Merge, and the long way up
eras.text: Spoon found a home at Merge Records in North Carolina and started building slowly: each record sold more than the last, and a piano song from Kill the Moonlight started turning up on television.

years.h: Love Ways EP, Spoon's first for Merge
years.p: Spoon's Merge debut is recorded without bassist Joshua Zarbo, who was temporarily away.

years.h: Girls Can Tell outsells both earlier albums combined
years.p: Britt Daniel names the Kinks, the Supremes and Elvis Costello's Get Happy!!, borrowed from Eleanor Friedberger, as influences.
years.xp: That was the first week of Girls Can Tell, which Daniel said was almost as much as A Series of Sneaks had sold in total. By 2009 it was just under 100,000.

years.h: Kill the Moonlight: tambourine, piano and space
years.p: Made with Mike McCarthy in Austin, it becomes one of Merge's biggest records. The Way We Get By lands in The O.C. and later Stranger than Fiction.
years.xp: Merge also reissued A Series of Sneaks in 2002 with both Laffitte songs as bonus tracks. Kill the Moonlight had sold around 153,000 by December 2009.

eras.title: Top artist of the decade
eras.text: From Gimme Fiction to Transference, each Spoon album debuted higher than the last, and critics kept the scores high. By 2010 they were on Saturday Night Live and in the Billboard top five.

years.h: Gimme Fiction enters the Billboard 200 at No. 44
years.p: Released by Merge in the US and by Matador in Europe.

years.h: Britt Daniel scores Stranger than Fiction; Rob Pope joins
years.p: Britt Daniel arranges the film's music with Brian Reitzell, mostly from Spoon songs. Rob Pope replaces Joshua Zarbo on bass.

years.h: Ga Ga Ga Ga Ga debuts at No. 10
years.p: Spoon plays Letterman, Conan, Austin City Limits and more to promote its sixth album.

years.h: Spoon plays The Underdog on Saturday Night Live
years.p: Spoon performs The Underdog and You Got Yr. Cherry Bomb on SNL.

years.h: Metacritic names Spoon top artist of the decade
years.p: Based on review scores from 2000 to 2009, no act rated better than Spoon.

years.h: Transference debuts at No. 4
years.p: 53,000 copies in the first week. That April, Spoon guests on Conan O'Brien's Legally Prohibited tour in Eugene, Oregon.

eras.title: Home to Matador
eras.text: Daniel took a side trip with a new band, then Spoon left Merge after five records. Two albums later it was back on Matador, the label it had walked away from in 1997.

years.h: Britt Daniel forms Divine Fits
years.p: Britt Daniel starts [[Divine Fits|0cc883bb-a8a5-4b8a-ba5c-ab4e6b9afc09]] with [[Wolf Parade|b7ddce8b-9e5c-46bd-9d33-41b134ce1a7f]]'s [[Dan Boeckner|142c1d98-df0e-4df5-b202-e63814693024]] and a member of [[New Bomb Turks|013d71e5-ecb2-486a-bd82-6e7d9129acfc]]. The band runs until 2013.

years.h: They Want My Soul · Loma Vista
years.p: Spoon's first after five on Merge, made with Joe Chiccarelli and Dave Fridmann. Pitchfork calls it the quintet's most booming record.

years.h: Hot Thoughts: Spoon back on Matador after 21 years
years.p: Spoon's ninth album is its first Matador release since Telephono in 1996. Eric Harvey leaves that year.

years.big: Can this guy do anyone's job?
q: So this guy can just do anyone's job, huh.
years.h: Pete Buttigieg plays The Way We Get By on piano
years.p: Presidential candidate Pete Buttigieg is filmed playing Spoon's The Way We Get By before a campaign event. Spoon answers on social media.

years.h: Rob Pope leaves Spoon
years.p: Bassist Rob Pope announces his exit weeks before Matador's best-of, Everything Hits at Once, comes out on July 26.

eras.title: Thirty years to a Grammy nod
eras.text: A pandemic held up the tenth album, but it got Spoon its first Grammy nomination nearly three decades in. The band keeps touring with the peers it came up with.

years.h: Spoon covers Tom Petty's Breakdown
years.p: Spoon releases covers of Tom Petty's Breakdown and A Face in the Crowd while the finished album waits out the pandemic.

years.h: Lucifer on the Sofa gets Spoon's first Grammy nod
years.p: Recorded at Jim Eno's studio from late 2018. In November it is nominated for Best Rock Album, and Adrian Sherwood remixes it as Lucifer on the Moon.

years.h: Spoon previews an 11th album and tours with Pixies
years.p: Spoon releases Chateau Blues and Guess I'm Fallin In Love and announces a tour with [[Pixies|b6b2bb8d-54a9-491f-9607-7b546023b433]]. In June 2026 it co-headlines with [[The Beths|4c74fc48-8108-4556-87af-154af74f2ce5]].
